overview: The City Council approved an appropriation of transportation network company surcharge funds for traffic calming projects, adopted a three percent local excise tax on adult-use marijuana, and scheduled a caucus to elect council leadership for the upcoming year.

items.title: Caucus for Council Leadership Election
items.summary: Approved a resolution scheduling a council caucus for October 27, 2020, to elect a council president and vice president for 2021, during which President Falco announced he would not seek another term.

items.title: Cost Estimate for Boston Avenue Resurfacing
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a DPW cost estimate to resurface Boston Avenue between Route 16 and Route 60.

items.title: CARES Act Funding Financial Report Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a detailed financial report from the city administration on the expenditure and balance of COVID-19 CARES Act funds.

items.title: Crosswalk Plans Near New Police Station
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the city traffic engineer to share plans for the crosswalk near the new police station and address safety concerns at Main and South streets.

items.title: 3% Local Excise Tax on Adult-Use Marijuana
items.summary: Adopted the provisions of M.G.L. Chapter 64N, Section 3 to impose a three percent local excise tax on adult-use marijuana sales.

items.title: Appropriation of TNC Surcharge Receipts and Traffic Safety Projects
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $136,129.20 in TNC surcharge funds for traffic safety and calming improvements across the city following an extensive discussion with Traffic Engineer Todd Blake.

items.title: Raised Crosswalk Commitments and Flashing Sign Audit
items.summary: Approved a B-paper requesting an update on previous commitments to install raised crosswalks on Central Avenue and Harvard Street, as well as an audit of malfunctioning flashing signs.

items.title: Condolences and Dedication in Memory of William J. Gay
items.summary: Approved a resolution extending condolences to the family of World War II veteran William J. Gay and dedicating the meeting in his memory.

items.title: Citation for Noah Kreatz and Veterans Preservation Project
items.summary: Approved a motion to invite resident Noah Kreatz to receive a council citation recognizing his work with the Veterans Preservation Project.

items.title: Committee Report: Committee of the Whole on Zoning
items.summary: Approved the report from the October 14, 2020 Committee of the Whole meeting regarding the city's zoning ordinance review with consultant Mark Bobrowski.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the records of the October 13, 2020 meeting as submitted.
